fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the DCMS serve as the foundation of planetary defense, providing the manpower essential to territorial control while freeing BattleMech and armored assets for offensive operations. Hover-mechanized infantry ride hovercraft that can cover ground faster than any tracked or wheeled formation in the DCMS inventory. District commanders prize these platoons for rapid redeployment between garrison posts, and during the Jihad, hover-mechanized troops proved their worth in the kind of hit-and-run resistance operations that the Dictum Honorium demanded of citizens on occupied worlds. Armed with standard assault rifles, the cheapest and most widely manufactured personal weapon in the Inner Sphere. Effective range is limited, but any world with basic industry can produce and stockpile them in quantity, and resupply is rarely a concern even on remote garrison posts.
